-- --------------------------------------------------------------
-- Announce the given time through the speaker (voice clips).
-- 输入 hour/minute（24 小时制），拼接 15 个预录语音片段播放：
--   14:30 → 现在是北京时间 十四点三十分
--   14:05 → 现在是北京时间 十四点零五分
--   14:00 → 现在是北京时间 十四点整
-- --------------------------------------------------------------

local arg_schema = require("arg_schema")
local audio = require("audio")
local bm = require("board_manager")

local DEFAULT_SKILL_DIR = "/system/skills/announce_time"

local ARG_SCHEMA = {
    hour = arg_schema.int({ default = -1, min = 0, max = 23 }),
    minute = arg_schema.int({ default = -1, min = 0, max = 59 }),
}

local ctx = arg_schema.parse(type(args) == "table" and args or {}, ARG_SCHEMA)

local function raw_arg(name)
    if type(args) == "table" and type(args[name]) == "string" and args[name] ~= "" then
        return args[name]
    end
    return nil
end

-- 0-59 的数字拆成中文片段名序列：
-- 1→digit1, 10→ten, 14→ten+digit4, 20→digit2+ten, 45→digit4+ten+digit5
local function append_number_clips(n, out)
    if n == 0 then
        table.insert(out, "digit0")
    elseif n < 10 then
        table.insert(out, "digit" .. n)
    elseif n == 10 then
        table.insert(out, "ten")
    elseif n < 20 then
        table.insert(out, "ten")
        table.insert(out, "digit" .. (n - 10))
    else
        table.insert(out, "digit" .. math.floor(n / 10))
        table.insert(out, "ten")
        if n % 10 ~= 0 then
            table.insert(out, "digit" .. (n % 10))
        end
    end
end

local function build_clip_names(hour, minute)
    local clips = { "prefix" }
    append_number_clips(hour, clips)
    table.insert(clips, "dian")
    if minute == 0 then
        table.insert(clips, "zheng")
    else
        if minute < 10 then
            table.insert(clips, "digit0")  -- 零五分
        end
        append_number_clips(minute, clips)
        table.insert(clips, "fen")
    end
    return clips
end

local skill_dir = raw_arg("skill_dir") or DEFAULT_SKILL_DIR
local audio_dir = skill_dir .. "/audio"

local codec, rate, channels, bits = bm.get_audio_codec_output_params("audio_dac")
if not codec then
    error("get_audio_codec_output_params(audio_dac) failed: " .. tostring(rate))
end

local output = assert(audio.new_output({ codec, rate, channels, bits, volume = 90 }))
local player = assert(audio.player({ output = output }))

local ok, err = xpcall(function()
    if ctx.hour < 0 or ctx.minute < 0 then
        error("args.hour and args.minute are required (0-23 / 0-59)")
    end

    local clips = build_clip_names(ctx.hour, ctx.minute)
    local info = output:info()
    print(string.format("[announce_time] %02d:%02d via %d clips, output=%dHz/%dch/%dbit",
                        ctx.hour, ctx.minute, #clips, info.sample_rate, info.channels, info.bits))

    for _, name in ipairs(clips) do
        player:play(audio_dir .. "/" .. name .. ".wav", { wait = true })
    end

    print(string.format("[announce_time] done: announced %02d:%02d", ctx.hour, ctx.minute))
end, debug.traceback)

pcall(function() player:close() end)
pcall(function() output:close() end)
if not ok then
    print("[announce_time] ERROR: " .. tostring(err))
    error(err)
end

-- --------------------------------------------------------------
-- 晨间播报：早上好，您今天有 X 个代办，已通过飞书发送给您，可以打开飞书进一步查看
-- 数字片段（digit0-9/ten）复用 announce_time skill 的音频目录。
-- --------------------------------------------------------------

local arg_schema = require("arg_schema")
local audio = require("audio")
local bm = require("board_manager")

local DEFAULT_BASE = "/system/skills"

local ARG_SCHEMA = {
    count = arg_schema.int({ default = -1, min = 0, max = 99 }),
}

local ctx = arg_schema.parse(type(args) == "table" and args or {}, ARG_SCHEMA)

local function raw_arg(name)
    if type(args) == "table" and type(args[name]) == "string" and args[name] ~= "" then
        return args[name]
    end
    return nil
end

-- 0-99 的数字拆成中文片段名序列（数字片段在 announce_time 的音频目录里）：
-- 3→digit3, 10→ten, 14→ten+digit4, 20→digit2+ten, 45→digit4+ten+digit5
local function append_number_clips(n, out)
    if n == 0 then
        table.insert(out, "digit0")
    elseif n < 10 then
        table.insert(out, "digit" .. n)
    elseif n == 10 then
        table.insert(out, "ten")
    elseif n < 20 then
        table.insert(out, "ten")
        table.insert(out, "digit" .. (n - 10))
    else
        table.insert(out, "digit" .. math.floor(n / 10))
        table.insert(out, "ten")
        if n % 10 ~= 0 then
            table.insert(out, "digit" .. (n % 10))
        end
    end
end

local skill_dir = raw_arg("skill_dir") or (DEFAULT_BASE .. "/announce_morning")
local morning_audio = skill_dir .. "/audio"

-- 数字片段目录：从本 skill 目录推导同级 announce_time，推导失败用默认路径
local digits_base = string.gsub(skill_dir, "announce_morning$", "announce_time")
if digits_base == skill_dir then
    digits_base = DEFAULT_BASE .. "/announce_time"
end
local digits_audio = digits_base .. "/audio"

local function build_clips(count)
    local clips = {
        { morning_audio, "morning" },
        { morning_audio, "you_have" },
    }
    local nums = {}
    append_number_clips(count, nums)
    for _, name in ipairs(nums) do
        table.insert(clips, { digits_audio, name })
    end
    table.insert(clips, { morning_audio, "count_word" })
    table.insert(clips, { morning_audio, "sent_feishu" })
    table.insert(clips, { morning_audio, "open_feishu" })
    return clips
end

local codec, rate, channels, bits = bm.get_audio_codec_output_params("audio_dac")
if not codec then
    error("get_audio_codec_output_params(audio_dac) failed: " .. tostring(rate))
end

local output = assert(audio.new_output({ codec, rate, channels, bits, volume = 90 }))
local player = assert(audio.player({ output = output }))

local ok, err = xpcall(function()
    if ctx.count < 0 then
        error("args.count is required (0-99)")
    end

    local clips = build_clips(ctx.count)
    local info = output:info()
    print(string.format("[announce_morning] %d todos via %d clips, output=%dHz/%dch/%dbit",
                        ctx.count, #clips, info.sample_rate, info.channels, info.bits))

    for _, clip in ipairs(clips) do
        player:play(clip[1] .. "/" .. clip[2] .. ".wav", { wait = true })
    end

    print(string.format("[announce_morning] done: announced %d todos", ctx.count))
end, debug.traceback)

pcall(function() player:close() end)
pcall(function() output:close() end)
if not ok then
    print("[announce_morning] ERROR: " .. tostring(err))
    error(err)
end

# epd_3in5g — ESP32-P4 智能电子工卡

ESP32-P4 + 3.5" 四色墨水屏 + MIPI 摄像头（SC2336）+ 麦克风 + 喇叭 + Android App
目标：一块智能电子工卡——手机 App 传图/文/语音显示，离线语音转文字，摄像头 OCR 识别，喇叭播报。

## 硬件

- **MCU**: ESP32-P4（chip rev v3.2，32MB Hex PSRAM，v6.1-beta1）
- **墨水屏**: Waveshare 3.5" 四色（184×384，黑/白/黄/红），bit-bang SPI
- **摄像头**: SC2336 MIPI CSI，1280×720 RAW8 → ISP → RGB565
- **I2C(SCCB)**: SDA=GPIO7, SCL=GPIO8
- **串口**: UART0 console（COM21，115200）

## 引脚分配

| 设备 | 信号 | GPIO |
|------|------|------|
| 墨水屏 | SCK | 21 |
| | MOSI | 22 |
| | CS | 33 |
| | DC | 32 |
| | RST | 6 |
| | BUSY | 20 |
| 摄像头 I2C | SDA | 7 |
| | SCL | 8 |

> 注意：ESP32-P4 的 GPIO 22~54 是 SPI flash/PSRAM 硬件脚，不能给外设用。墨水屏 CS=33/DC=32 虽在 PSRAM reserve 区，但实测可用（reserve 只是软件标记）。安全 GPIO 是 0~21。

## 已完成

- ✅ **M1 墨水屏显示链路**：Python 工具 `tools/img2epd.py` 把任意图片转 4 色 2bit 数据（含 Floyd-Steinberg 抖动），通过串口或 C 数组烧录显示。验证了引脚、bit-bang SPI、`EPD_3IN5G_V2_Display`。
  - 根因记录：`EPD_3IN5G_V2_Init_Fast()` 对预置数组数据不工作，改用普通 `Init()`。
- ✅ **PSRAM 开启**：`CONFIG_SPIRAM=y`，250MHz，32MB，1MB 分配测试通过。
- ✅ **摄像头打通**：SC2336 MIPI CSI 探测成功（PID=0xcb3a），CSI+ISP 初始化完成，1280×720 RGB565。
- ✅ **协议框架**：`epd_protocol` 统一帧协议（帧头 0xA5 0x5A | CMD | LEN | PAYLOAD | CRC16），串口/蓝牙复用。支持 CMD_IMAGE(0x01) 显示图片、CMD_CAPTURE(0x05) 触发拍照、CMD_CAPTURE_JPG(0x06) 回传 JPG。
- ✅ **JPEG 硬件编码**：`jpeg_encoder.cpp` 用 P4 硬件 JPEG codec，RGB565→JPG。

## 进行中

- 🔄 **M3 摄像头拍照串口传回**：摄像头已初始化，JPEG 编码就绪，串口回传待调试（UART0 console 复用 RX 抢占问题）。

## 待办

- [ ] M2 录音转文字（PDM 麦 + esp-sr / 手机端 ASR）
- [ ] M3+ 拍照显示到墨水屏（RGB565→4色2bit 转换）
- [ ] M4 喇叭播报（MAX98357A I2S）
- [ ] M5 Android App 集成

## 目录结构

```
epd_3in5g/
├── main/
│   ├── main.cpp              # app_main 入口
│   ├── DEV_Config.h/.cpp     # 墨水屏 GPIO + bit-bang SPI
│   ├── EPD_3in5g_V2.h/.cpp   # 墨水屏驱动（Waveshare 移植）
│   ├── EPD_3in5g_V2_test.cpp # 显示测试入口
│   ├── GUI_Paint.h/.cpp      # 绘图库
│   ├── ImageData.cpp         # 图片数据（test.png 转换的 C 数组）
│   ├── fonts*.cpp             # 字库
│   ├── camera_capture.h/.cpp # SC2336 CSI+ISP 拍照
│   ├── jpeg_encoder.h/.cpp   # 硬件 JPEG 编码
│   ├── epd_protocol.h/.cpp   # 串口协议 + 命令分发
│   ├── CMakeLists.txt
│   └── idf_component.yml     # 依赖 esp_cam_sensor + sensor_init
├── tools/
│   ├── img2epd.py            # 图片→4色2bit→串口发送/C数组
│   └── recv_jpg.py           # 触发拍照+接收 JPG
├── test.png                  # 测试图片
├── sdkconfig                 # PSRAM 已开
├── CMakeLists.txt
└── 智能电子工卡_开发计划.md    # 整体规划
```

## 编译烧录

```bash
idf.py set-target esp32p4
idf.py build

```

> 需要 ESP-IDF v6.1-beta1，PSRAM 配置（`CONFIG_SPIRAM=y`，`CONFIG_SPIRAM_MODE_HEX=y`，`CONFIG_SPIRAM_SPEED_250M=y`）。
> menuconfig 需开启 `Component config → esp_cam_sensor → SC2336`。

# epd_3in5g — ESP32-P4 智能电子工卡

ESP32-P4 + 3.5" 四色墨水屏 + MIPI 摄像头 + ES8311 喇叭 + BLE/以太网，目标：一块智能电子工卡——手机 App 交互、语音转文字、拍照识别、语音播报、IM 远程操控。

> **主文档：[docs/完整工作流.md](docs/完整工作流.md)** —— 硬件引脚、各模块数据流、踩坑记录、完整启动流程都在里面，本 README 只做概览。

## 硬件平台

| 芯片 | 角色 | 核心能力 |
|------|------|----------|
| ESP32-P4 (rev v3.2) | 主控 | 32MB Hex PSRAM、MIPI CSI、硬件 JPEG、以太网 EMAC、墨水屏 bit-bang SPI |
| ESP32-C6-MINI-1 | 协处理器 | WiFi 6 / BLE 5，经 SDIO + ESP-Hosted v3.0.6 桥接给 P4 |

## 当前状态

### 已完成 ✅

| 里程碑 | 内容 | 验证方式 |
|--------|------|----------|
| M1 墨水屏 | 4 色 2bit 显示（184×384），Floyd-Steinberg 抖动，开机显示测试图 | `tools/img2epd.py` |
| M3 摄像头+以太网 | SC2336 1280×720 → 硬件 JPEG → TCP :8080 回传，连续拍照 | `python tools/capture_tcp.py --ip <IP> --port 8080` |
| M4 喇叭 | ES8311 codec（I2C 配置 + I2S 播放），开机语音，音量 90 | 上电自动播放 `voice_prompt.pcm` |
| BLE | SPP Server 走 ESP-Hosted 桥接 C6，服务 0xABF0 | nRF Connect 连 `ESP_SPP_SERVER` |
| 时间播报 | BLE 推时间（`SETTIME`/`ANNOUNCE`/`TIME?` 命令），15 个 TTS 片段拼接播报 | `python tools/ble_time.py` |
| 存储 | 16MB flash 自定义分区表，app 分区拉满 15.94MB | `partitions.csv` |

### 待办

- [ ] M2 语音转文字（录音 → 文本；需自建 STT 链路）
- [ ] M3+ 拍照显示到墨水屏（RGB565 → 4 色 2bit）
- [ ] 定时自动播报（整点报时，穿戴设备逻辑）
- [ ] WiFi + SNTP 自主对时（C6 出网，摆脱对端推时间）
- [ ] M5 Android App（校时/指令复用现有 BLE SPP 通道）

> 另有一条并行线：**esp-claw**（乐鑫设备端 AI Agent 框架）已移植到本板（以太网版），支持飞书/微信对话操控摄像头、墨水屏、喇叭；其中的语音播报 skill 备份在本仓库 `esp-claw-skills` 分支。

## 引脚分配（摘要）

| 功能 | GPIO |
|------|------|
| 墨水屏 SCK / MOSI / CS / DC / RST / BUSY | 21 / 22 / 33 / 32 / **5** / 20 |
| 摄像头 I2C SDA / SCL | 7 / 8 |
| 喇叭 I2S MCLK / BCLK / WS / DOUT / DIN | 13 / 12 / 10 / 9 / 11 |
| 喇叭 PA 使能 | 53 |
| SDIO→C6 CLK / CMD / D0~D3 | 18 / 19 / 14~17 |
| C6 EN | 54（硬件上拉，常使能） |
| 以太网 | RMII EMAC（板载 PHY） |
| Console UART | 37(TX) / 38(RX)，COM21 |

完整引脚表与说明见 [docs/完整工作流.md](docs/完整工作流.md)。
GPIO6 留给 C6 WAKEUP 备用，墨水屏 RST 用 5。

## 目录结构

```
epd_3in5g/
├── main/
│   ├── main.cpp               # 启动流程：墨水屏→摄像头→喇叭→时间播报→以太网→BLE→TCP
│   ├── DEV_Config / EPD_3in5g_V2 / GUI_Paint / ImageData / fonts*   # 墨水屏驱动
│   ├── camera_capture.cpp     # SC2336 CSI+ISP 拍照
│   ├── jpeg_encoder.cpp       # 硬件 JPEG 编码
│   ├── eth_init.cpp           # 以太网（DHCP→静态回退）
│   ├── tcp_server.cpp         # TCP :8080 拍照服务
│   ├── ble_spp_server_demo.c  # BLE SPP Server（ESP-Hosted C6）
│   ├── audio_speaker.c        # ES8311 喇叭驱动
│   ├── time_announce.c        # 时间播报（对时+拼接播放任务）
│   ├── voice_clips.c/.h       # 15 个报时语音片段（自动生成）
│   └── voice_prompt.pcm       # 开机语音
├── tools/
│   ├── img2epd.py             # 图片→4色2bit→串口/C数组
│   ├── capture_tcp.py         # TCP 拍照客户端
│   ├── ble_time.py            # BLE 对时+播报测试（pip install bleak）
│   ├── gen_voice_clips.py     # 报时片段生成（Windows TTS 离线）
│   └── wav2pcm.py             # wav→16k/16bit/mono PCM
├── partitions.csv             # 16MB 分区表（app 15.94MB）
├── docs/完整工作流.md          # 主文档
└── c6_ble_bridge/             # 已弃用（改用 ESP-Hosted）
```

## 编译烧录

```bash
idf.py build flash monitor
```

- ESP-IDF **v6.1-beta1**（EIM 安装：`C:\esp\v6.1-beta1\esp-idf` + `C:\Espressif` 工具链）
- 终端：开始菜单 "ESP-IDF PowerShell"，或 `. C:\Espressif\tools\Microsoft.v6.1-beta1.PowerShell_profile.ps1`
- 分区表/flash 大小已入仓库配置（`partitions.csv` + `sdkconfig.defaults`），无需 menuconfig
- menuconfig 需确认：`Camera → SC2336`、`Bluetooth → Bluedroid`、`ESP-Hosted → Bluetooth`

## 关键文档

- [docs/完整工作流.md](docs/完整工作流.md) — 硬件、数据流、踩坑、启动流程（主文档）
- [docs/ethernet_debug.md](docs/ethernet_debug.md) — 以太网调试记录
- `esp-claw-skills` 分支 — esp-claw 语音播报 skill 快照（报时 + 晨间待办播报）

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""临时排查脚本：验证抖动对文字清晰度的影响。
生成文字测试图 → img2epd 转换（开/关抖动）→ 解码回 PNG 对比。
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))

from img2epd import PALETTE, WIDTH, HEIGHT, convert_image  # noqa: E402
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont  # noqa: E402

# 1. 文字测试图：直接按屏幕原生分辨率绘制（排除缩放干扰，纯看量化+抖动）
img = Image.new("RGB", (WIDTH, HEIGHT), (255, 255, 255))
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
try:
    f_big = ImageFont.truetype("C:/Windows/Fonts/msyh.ttc", 28)
    f_small = ImageFont.truetype("C:/Windows/Fonts/msyh.ttc", 16)
except Exception:
    f_big = f_small = ImageFont.load_default()
d.text((8, 20), "智能电子工卡", fill=(0, 0, 0), font=f_big)
d.text((8, 60), "文字清晰度测试 ABC 123", fill=(0, 0, 0), font=f_small)
d.text((8, 90), "灰色抗锯齿边缘", fill=(60, 60, 60), font=f_small)
d.rectangle([8, 130, 100, 150], fill=(128, 128, 128))   # 中灰块
d.rectangle([8, 160, 100, 180], fill=(0, 120, 200))     # 蓝色块（不在调色板内）
d.rectangle([8, 190, 100, 210], fill=(240, 240, 240))   # 浅灰块
img.save(HERE / "_text_source.png")


# 2. 解码：2bit payload → RGB PNG（模拟屏幕实际显示）
def decode(payload: bytes) -> Image.Image:
    im = Image.new("RGB", (WIDTH, HEIGHT))
    p = im.load()
    row_bytes = WIDTH // 4
    for y in range(HEIGHT):
        for i in range(row_bytes):
            b = payload[y * row_bytes + i]
            for k in range(4):
                idx = (b >> (6 - 2 * k)) & 0x3
                p[i * 4 + k, y] = PALETTE[idx]
    return im


# 3. 开/关抖动各转一遍
for name, dith in [("nodither", False), ("dither", True)]:
    payload = convert_image(img, dither=dith)
    decode(payload).save(HERE / f"_text_{name}.png")
    print(f"生成 _text_{name}.png")

# 4. 宽高比问题单独验证：方图硬拉到 184x384 的形变
square = Image.new("RGB", (384, 384), (255, 255, 255))
ds = ImageDraw.Draw(square)
ds.text((40, 180), "正方形输入 ABC", fill=(0, 0, 0), font=f_big)
payload = convert_image(square, dither=False)
decode(payload).save(HERE / "_text_stretch.png")
print("生成 _text_stretch.png（384x384 方图被硬拉到 184x384）")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""临时排查：大图缩到屏幕分辨率时，重采样滤波器对文字边缘的影响。
metric: 缩放后"中间灰"像素数——边缘越糊中间灰越多，越锐利越少。
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))

from img2epd import WIDTH, HEIGHT  # noqa: E402
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageResampling  # noqa: E402

# 3 倍屏幕尺寸绘制（模拟手机截图/高清输入：552x1152）
SW, SH = WIDTH * 3, HEIGHT * 3
img = Image.new("RGB", (SW, SH), (255, 255, 255))
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
f = ImageFont.truetype("C:/Windows/Fonts/msyh.ttc", 84)
d.text((24, 60), "智能电子工卡", fill=(0, 0, 0), font=f)
d.text((24, 200), "文字清晰度测试", fill=(0, 0, 0), font=f)
img.save(HERE / "_resize_source.png")


def midtones(im):
    """中间灰像素：既不接近黑也不接近白的像素（文字边缘过渡带）"""
    px = im.load()
    n = 0
    for y in range(im.size[1]):
        for x in range(im.size[0]):
            r, g, b = px[x, y]
            v = (r + g + b) // 3
            if 40 < v < 215:
                n += 1
    return n


print("缩放后中间灰像素（越多=边缘越糊）:")
for name in ("BICUBIC(默认)", "LANCZOS", "BOX(均值)", "NEAREST"):
    resample = {
        "BICUBIC(默认)": ImageResampling.BICUBIC,
        "LANCZOS": ImageResampling.LANCZOS,
        "BOX(均值)": ImageResampling.BOX,
        "NEAREST": ImageResampling.NEAREST,
    }[name]
    small = img.resize((WIDTH, HEIGHT), resample)
    print("  %-12s %d" % (name, midtones(small)))
    small.save(HERE / ("_resize_%s.png" % name.split("(")[0]))

## 三个实验的数据

**实验 1：纯黑白文字，开关抖动对比**（屏幕原生分辨率绘制，排除缩放干扰）

| 指标 | 关抖动 | 开抖动 |

| 全图黑像素 | 4479 | 5071（+13%） |

**实验 2：灰色内容（这就是关键）**

| 区域（1863 像素） | 关抖动 | 开抖动 |
|---|---|---|
| 中灰块(128) | 0 黑（整块变白） | **996 黑 = 53% 噪点** |
| 浅灰块(240) | 0 黑 | 122 黑（6% 稀疏黑点） |

**实验 3：大图缩放到 184 宽**——BICUBIC/LANCZOS/BOX 差异仅 ±10%，但全部产生 ~2000 个**中间灰像素**（= 文字抗锯齿过渡带）。

## 结论：文字发糊的完整链条

```
大图缩到 184 宽 → 文字边缘全是中间灰过渡带（实验3）

灰边被误差扩散成黑点盐粒噪声（实验2：灰=53%噪点）
      ↓
字形边缘毛糙 → "文字不清晰"
```

**Answer: 对，两个工程现状都不支持任意中文直接显示：**

1. **esp-claw 移植**：`epaper_text` 只实现了 ASCII 点阵（font8/16/24），SKILL.md 明确 "ASCII only"。AI 在墨水屏上只能写英文/数字。（esp-claw 系统分区里有 NotoSansSC 中文字体 TTF，但那是给 LVGL/LCD 用的，墨水屏路径没接）

2. **epd_3in5g 工程**：驱动栈里有 `Paint_DrawString_CN` API（Waveshare 原装），CMake 也编了 font12CN/24CN——但那两份字库是**演示用的残缺版**：font24CN 只有 27 个字（"你好微雪电子"那套），font12CN 只有 9 个。显示任意中文 = 不支持。

**为什么当初走图片路线**：图片路线（img2epd.py / CMD_IMAGE）在 PC/手机端渲染，字体、排版、彩色全都上游解决，固件只管收 17KB 位图——这是绕开字体问题的捷径，也是 M5 App 的设计路径。

**如果要支持固件端直接显示中文**（比如 esp-claw 的 AI 直接往屏上写中文，或 BLE 收到短文本直接显示，不用传整图），方案：

| 方案 | 说明 | 成本 |
|------|------|------|
| A. 生成 GB2312 常用字库（点阵） | 用 Python 从 Windows TTF 渲染 3755 个一级常用字 → 24×24 点阵 C 数组，~270KB（flash 有 15.94MB 随便放）；接 Paint_DrawString_CN 或重写个 UTF-8 → 查表的绘制函数 | 一次性生成脚本 + 驱动小改，1-2 小时 |
| B. UTF-8 直接渲染 + TTF (FreeType) | 移植 FreeType + NotoSansSC-sub.ttf（esp-claw 已带！），任意字渲染 | 重一些，esp-claw 侧可以做 |
| C. 继续走图片路线 | PC/App 端渲染，固件不碰字体 | 零改动（现状） |

推荐：工卡产品最终大概率是 C（App 端渲染），但 esp-claw 的 AI 对话场景"把这段话显示到墨水屏"现在只能英文——这个用 A 补上最划算（生成脚本我可以马上写，顺便把 esp-claw 的 epaper_text 扩展 UTF-8 中文支持）。

Also mention the encoding trap: GB2312 vs UTF-8 — if we generate the font ourselves we'll key it by Unicode codepoint (UTF-8 decode in firmware, lookup by codepoint) which avoids the GB2312 encoding mess entirely. That's the right design: font table indexed by Unicode, drawing function decodes UTF-8.

## 现状

| 工程 | 中文支持 | 实情 |

这也解释了为什么当初 M1 直接走**图片路线**：PC 端渲染好再传 17KB 位图，字体/排版/彩色全在上游解决，固件完全不碰字体问题。

## 如果要固件端直接显示中文

三个方案：

| 方案 | 思路 | 成本 |
|------|------|------|
| **A. 自生成点阵字库** | Python 从 Windows 字体渲染 **GB2312 一级 3755 常用字** → 24×24 点阵 C 数组（~270KB，flash 还有 15MB 随便放）；顺便按 **Unicode 码点索引**重写查表逻辑，绕开 Waveshare 那套 GB2312 编码坑 | 生成脚本 + 驱动小改，1~2 小时 |

| C. 维持图片路线 | App/PC 端渲染，固件只收位图 | 零改动 |

**我的判断**：工卡产品形态最终大概率是 C（M5 App 传图）。但 esp-claw 那边有个真实痛点——“帮我把这段话显示到墨水屏”这种 AI 对话指令现在只能写英文。用 **A** 补上最划算：我写个生成脚本（复用 gen_time_clips_wav.py 的套路，字体用微软雅黑），esp-claw 的 `epaper_text` 加个 UTF-8 解码 + 码点查表，两边工程都能用。

### Boot Button (BOOT / GPIO34)
- The **BOOT button** on the ESP32-P4-Function-EVB-Board is connected to **GPIO34**
- It is typically connected between **GPIO34** and **GND** with a **pull-up resistor**
- This button is used to enter download/bootloader mode when held during reset
- Pressing BOOT (GPIO34) during power-on or reset puts the ESP32-P4 into serial bootloader mode

```
VCC (3.3V) ---[10KΩ Pull-up]---+--- GPIO34 (BOOT)

                                 |
                                GND
```

- **RESET (RST) button** — connected to the chip's enable/reset pin (EN pin), typically also active-low with a pull-up resistor
- Some configurations may include an additional **user-configurable button** depending on the revision

### Key Notes:
- GPIO34 on ESP32-P4 is a **general-purpose GPIO** and input-capable pin
- The BOOT button is essential for firmware flashing via UART

```c
/*
 * screen_switcher - BOOT 键(GPIO34) 循环切换墨水屏界面
 * 按一次切下一屏（工卡→天气日历→待办→工卡），刷新期间忽略按键。
 * 注意：epd_protocol 若启用需加 EPD 互斥（当前未启动，无并发）。
 */
#include <stdio.h>
#include "freertos/FreeRTOS.h"
#include "freertos/task.h"
#include "esp_log.h"
#include "driver/gpio.h"
#include "DEV_Config.h"
#include "EPD_3in5g_V2.h"
#include "ui_screens.h"
#include "screen_switcher.h"

static const char *TAG = "switcher";

#define BUTTON_GPIO     34      /* 板载 BOOT 键，按下接地（外接按键：改脚位，另一端接 GND） */
#define POLL_MS         20      /* 轮询周期 */
#define DEBOUNCE_TICKS  3       /* 3×20ms 稳定判定 */

static int s_index;
static volatile bool s_refreshing;

static void show_screen(int idx)
{
    s_refreshing = true;
    EPD_3IN5G_V2_Init();                        /* 从 Sleep 唤醒 */
    EPD_3IN5G_V2_Display(ui_screens[idx]);
    EPD_3IN5G_V2_Sleep();
    s_refreshing = false;
}

static void button_task(void *arg)
{
    int stable = 1, count = 0;                  /* 上电默认高（松开） */
    while (1) {
        int raw = gpio_get_level(BUTTON_GPIO);
        if (raw != stable) {
            if (++count >= DEBOUNCE_TICKS) {
                stable = raw;
                count = 0;
                if (stable == 0 && !s_refreshing) {   /* 下降沿=按下 */
                    s_index = (s_index + 1) % UI_SCREEN_COUNT;
                    ESP_LOGI(TAG, "切到 [%d] %s", s_index, ui_screen_names[s_index]);
                    show_screen(s_index);
                }
            }
        } else {
            count = 0;
        }
        vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(POLL_MS));
    }
}

void screen_switcher_start(int start_index)
{
    s_index = start_index % UI_SCREEN_COUNT;

    gpio_config_t io = {
        .pin_bit_mask = 1ULL << BUTTON_GPIO,
        .mode = GPIO_MODE_INPUT,
        .pull_up_en = GPIO_PULLUP_ENABLE,
    };
    ESP_ERROR_CHECK(gpio_config(&io));

    xTaskCreate(button_task, "btn_switch", 4096, NULL, 5, NULL);
    ESP_LOGI(TAG, "按键切屏就绪：GPIO%d，当前 [%d] %s",
             BUTTON_GPIO, s_index, ui_screen_names[s_index]);
}

此前已验证抖动会糊化文字边缘）。内容为演示占位，动态数据后续走 BLE 推图，
显示通路不变。

用法:
    python tools/gen_ui_screens.py

改内容（姓名/待办/天气）直接编辑下方 CONFIG，重新运行即可。
"""
import datetime
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))

from img2epd import WIDTH, HEIGHT, convert_image  # noqa: E402
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont  # noqa: E402

OUT_C = HERE.parent / "main" / "ui_screens.c"
OUT_H = HERE.parent / "main" / "ui_screens.h"
SCREEN_BYTES = WIDTH // 4 * HEIGHT  # 17664

# ---------------- 演示内容（占位，后续动态化） ----------------
CONFIG = {
    "company": "智能科技有限公司",
    "name": "张 三",
    "title": "硬件工程师",
    "dept": "研发一部",
    "employee_id": "10086",
    "weather": {"cond": "晴", "temp": "28°C", "range": "20~29°C", "wind": "东南风 2 级"},
    "todos": [
        ("评审 P4 原理图", True),
        ("回复供应商邮件", False),
        ("跟进相机驱动 bug", False),
        ("整理墨水屏文档", False),
        ("准备周会材料", False),
    ],
}

BLACK = (0, 0, 0)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
RED = (255, 0, 0)
YELLOW = (255, 255, 0)
WEEK_CN = "一二三四五六日"


def font(size, bold=False):
    path = "C:/Windows/Fonts/msyhbd.ttc" if bold else "C:/Windows/Fonts/msyh.ttc"
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
    except OSError:
        return ImageFont.truetype("C:/Windows/Fonts/msyh.ttc", size)


def text_centered(d, cx, y, s, f, fill):
    """以 cx 为水平中心画文本"""
    bb = d.textbbox((0, 0), s, font=f)
    d.text((cx - (bb[2] - bb[0]) // 2, y), s, font=f, fill=fill)


def text_width(d, s, f):
    return d.textbbox((0, 0), s, font=f)[2]


def draw_footer(d, idx, label):
    """黄色底栏：页码 + 界面名（所有屏统一，切到哪一屏一目了然）"""
    d.rectangle([0, HEIGHT - 22, WIDTH - 1, HEIGHT - 1], fill=YELLOW)
    text_centered(d, WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT - 19, "%d/3 · %s" % (idx + 1, label),
                  font(12), BLACK)


def new_screen():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (WIDTH, HEIGHT), WHITE)
    return img, ImageDraw.Draw(img)


# ---------------- 界面 1：工卡（开机首屏） ----------------
def draw_badge():
    img, d = new_screen()
    d.rectangle([0, 0, WIDTH - 1, 32], fill=RED)
    text_centered(d, WIDTH // 2, 8, CONFIG["company"], font(14), WHITE)

    # 照片占位框 80x96
    d.rectangle([52, 50, 131, 145], outline=BLACK, width=2)
    text_centered(d, WIDTH // 2, 86, "照片", font(14), BLACK)

    text_centered(d, WIDTH // 2, 160, CONFIG["name"], font(30, bold=True), BLACK)
    text_centered(d, WIDTH // 2, 214, CONFIG["title"], font(18), BLACK)
    text_centered(d, WIDTH // 2, 244, CONFIG["dept"], font(14), BLACK)

    d.line([24, 280, WIDTH - 24, 280], fill=BLACK)
    text_centered(d, WIDTH // 2, 292, "工号 %s" % CONFIG["employee_id"],
                  font(14), BLACK)
    draw_footer(d, 0, "工卡")
    return img


# ---------------- 界面 2：天气日历 ----------------
def draw_weather():
    now = datetime.datetime.now()
    img, d = new_screen()
    d.rectangle([0, 0, WIDTH - 1, 32], fill=RED)
    text_centered(d, WIDTH // 2, 8, "%d年%d月" % (now.year, now.month),
                  font(14), WHITE)

    text_centered(d, WIDTH // 2, 44, str(now.day), font(56, bold=True), BLACK)
    text_centered(d, WIDTH // 2, 126, "星期" + WEEK_CN[now.weekday()],
                  font(18), BLACK)

    w = CONFIG["weather"]
    text_centered(d, WIDTH // 2, 166, "%s  %s" % (w["cond"], w["temp"]),
                  font(22, bold=True), BLACK)
    text_centered(d, WIDTH // 2, 204, "%s · %s" % (w["range"], w["wind"]),
                  font(13), BLACK)

    d.line([16, 236, WIDTH - 16, 236], fill=BLACK)

    # 本周日历：周一~周日，今天黄底高亮
    monday = now - datetime.timedelta(days=now.weekday())
    col_w, y_hd, y_num = 24, 250, 274
    x0 = (WIDTH - 7 * col_w) // 2 + col_w // 2
    for i in range(7):
        day = monday + datetime.timedelta(days=i)
        cx = x0 + i * col_w
        text_centered(d, cx, y_hd, WEEK_CN[i], font(13), BLACK)
        if day.date() == now.date():
            d.rectangle([cx - 11, y_num - 4, cx + 11, y_num + 18], fill=YELLOW)
        text_centered(d, cx, y_num, str(day.day), font(14), BLACK)

    draw_footer(d, 1, "天气日历")
    return img


# ---------------- 界面 3：待办 ----------------
def draw_todo():
    img, d = new_screen()
    d.rectangle([0, 0, WIDTH - 1, 32], fill=RED)
    d.text((12, 7), "今日待办", font=font(16), fill=WHITE)

    y, row_h = 52, 42
    for text, done in CONFIG["todos"]:
        if done:  # 红色实心块 = 已完成
            d.rectangle([12, y + 2, 24, y + 14], fill=RED)
        else:
            d.rectangle([12, y + 2, 24, y + 14], outline=BLACK, width=1)
        d.text((34, y), text, font=font(15), fill=BLACK)
        if done:  # 删除线
            tw = text_width(d, text, font(15))
            d.line([34, y + 10, 34 + tw, y + 10], fill=BLACK, width=1)
        y += row_h

    done_n = sum(1 for _, done in CONFIG["todos"] if done)
    d.line([16, y + 6, WIDTH - 16, y + 6], fill=BLACK)
    text_centered(d, WIDTH // 2, y + 18, "共 %d 项 · 已完成 %d 项"
                  % (len(CONFIG["todos"]), done_n), font(13), BLACK)

    draw_footer(d, 2, "待办")
    return img


def emit_c(payloads):
    lines = [
        "/* 自动生成：tools/gen_ui_screens.py，勿手改 */",
        "#include \"ui_screens.h\"",
        "",
    ]
    for name, data in payloads:
        lines.append("const unsigned char %s[%d] = {" % (name, len(data)))
        for i in range(0, len(data), 16):
            lines.append("    " + ",".join("0x%02X" % b for b in data[i:i + 16]) + ",")
        lines.append("};")
        lines.append("")
    lines += [
        "/* 按键循环顺序：0=工卡 1=天气日历 2=待办 */",
        "const unsigned char *const ui_screens[UI_SCREEN_COUNT] = {",
        "    ui_screen_badge, ui_screen_weather, ui_screen_todo,",
        "};",
        "",
        "const char *const ui_screen_names[UI_SCREEN_COUNT] = {",
        '    "工卡", "天气日历", "待办",',
        "};",
        "",
    ]
    return "\n".join(lines)


def main():
    screens = [
        ("ui_screen_badge", draw_badge()),
        ("ui_screen_weather", draw_weather()),
        ("ui_screen_todo", draw_todo()),
    ]
    payloads = [(name, convert_image(img, dither=False)) for name, img in screens]
    for (name, _), (_, data) in zip(screens, payloads):
        assert len(data) == SCREEN_BYTES, "%s size %d != %d" % (name, len(data), SCREEN_BYTES)

    OUT_H.write_text(
        "/* 自动生成：tools/gen_ui_screens.py，勿手改 */\n"
        "#ifndef _UI_SCREENS_H_\n"
        "#define _UI_SCREENS_H_\n\n"
        "#define UI_SCREEN_COUNT 3\n"
        "#define UI_SCREEN_BYTES %d\n\n" % SCREEN_BYTES +
        "extern const unsigned char ui_screen_badge[UI_SCREEN_BYTES];\n"
        "extern const unsigned char ui_screen_weather[UI_SCREEN_BYTES];\n"
        "extern const unsigned char ui_screen_todo[UI_SCREEN_BYTES];\n\n"
        "/* 按键循环顺序：0=工卡 1=天气日历 2=待办 */\n"
        "extern const unsigned char *const ui_screens[UI_SCREEN_COUNT];\n"
        "extern const char *const ui_screen_names[UI_SCREEN_COUNT];\n\n"
        "#endif\n",
        encoding="ascii",
    )
    OUT_C.write_text(emit_c(payloads), encoding="ascii")
    print("wrote %s (%d screens x %d bytes)" % (OUT_C, len(payloads), SCREEN_BYTES))
    print("wrote %s" % OUT_H)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""临时校验：三屏预览的结构检查（顶栏/底栏/内容/边界溢出）"""
from PIL import Image
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).parent
PAL = {(0, 0, 0): "black", (255, 255, 255): "white", (255, 0, 0): "red", (255, 255, 0): "yellow"}


def row_colors(im, y):
    px = im.load()
    c = {}
    for x in range(im.size[0]):
        k = PAL.get(px[x, y], "other")
        c[k] = c.get(k, 0) + 1
    return c


def col_has_ink(im, x):
    px = im.load()
    for y in range(im.size[1]):
        if px[x, y] != (255, 255, 255):
            return True
    return False


for name in ("badge", "weather", "todo"):
    im = Image.open(HERE / ("_preview_%s.png" % name)).convert("RGB")
    W, H = im.size
    top = row_colors(im, 5)          # 顶栏应为红底白字
    foot = row_colors(im, H - 5)     # 底栏应为黄底黑字
    mid = row_colors(im, H // 2)     # 中部应有内容
    # 边界溢出：最左/最右 2px 列是否有内容（footer 整宽黄条除外）
    edge_l = any(col_has_ink(im, 0) or col_has_ink(im, 1) for _ in [0])
    edge_r = col_has_ink(im, W - 1) or col_has_ink(im, W - 2)
    print("--- %s (%dx%d) ---" % (name, W, H))
    print("  top5:  %s" % top)
    print("  mid:   %s" % mid)
    print("  foot:  %s" % foot)
    print("  edge-L ink(band-rows excluded?): %s  edge-R: %s" % (edge_l, edge_r))

## SD 卡存储 — 拍照/录音落卡（待上板验证）

### 架构
```
GPIO45 SD_PWRn 上电（高 100ms 复位 → 低供电 250ms）
  → SDMMC SLOT_0（4-bit，GPIO39-44）→ FATFS 挂 /sdcard
拍照: TCP CAPTURE → JPEG → 回传 PC + 存 /sdcard/photo/P_时间戳.jpg
录音: BLE "REC <秒>" → ES8311 ADC → I2S RX → /sdcard/rec/R_时间戳.wav
```

### 与 ESP-Hosted 共存（关键）
- **SLOT_1 被 C6 SDIO 占用**（GPIO14-19），SD 卡必须用 SLOT_0
- IDF≥6.0 全局 `sdmmc_host_init()` 只能调一次；ESP-Hosted 构造函数
  （`CONFIG_ESP_HOSTED_AUTO_CALL_INIT_BEFORE_APP_MAIN`）已在 app_main 前调过，
  所以 sd_storage 里 `host.init/deinit` 置 dummy（esp_hosted 官方共存例程同款）

### BLE 新命令
| 命令 | 说明 | 响应 |
|------|------|------|
| `REC <1-60>` | 录音 N 秒存 SD | `OK REC START` → 完成后 `OK REC /sdcard/rec/R_xxx.wav <字节>B`；无卡 `ERR NOCARD`，录声中 `BUSY` |
| `SD?` | 查卡状态 | `SD OK <容量>MB free <剩余>MB` / `SD NOCARD` |

### 关键点
- **SD_PWRn 低有效**（名字 n + esp_hosted 例程时序佐证）；若卡始终不识别，优先翻转 [sd_storage.c](../main/sd_storage.c) 里 `sd_power_on()` 的电平
- 卡要 FAT32（exFAT 不支持）；**不自动格式化**（防误删卡内数据）
- 无卡只告警不阻塞开机；文件名时间戳（需先 SETTIME 对时），未对时用序号命名扫目录递增
- 录音 16k/16bit/mono WAV，mic 增益 30dB（`ES8311_MIC_GAIN_DB` 宏可调）；
  若录音无声：mic 数据可能在右槽位，`es8311_record_wav()` 里 `stereo[i*2]` 换 `stereo[i*2+1]`
- 内部上拉偏弱，板上最好有 10K 外部上拉（EVB 正常设计都有）

1	# arg_schema
2	
3	`arg_schema` normalizes the global `args` table into predictable Lua values before a script uses hardware APIs or long-running logic.
4	
5	Load it with:
6	
7	```lua
8	local arg_schema = require("arg_schema")
9	```
10	
11	This library is a normalization helper, not a strict validator. It does not return validation errors. Bad or missing input is converted to configured defaults.
12	
13	## Typical Pattern
14	
15	Define the schema once near the top of the script, parse `args` once, then use the returned context table everywhere.
16	
17	```lua
18	local arg_schema = require("arg_schema")
19	
20	local ctx = arg_schema.parse(args, {
21	    io = arg_schema.int({ default = 38, min = 0 }),
22	    enabled = arg_schema.bool({ default = true }),
23	    color = arg_schema.object({
24	        fields = {
25	            r = arg_schema.int({ default = 255, min = 0, max = 255 }),
26	            g = arg_schema.int({ default = 255, min = 0, max = 255 }),
27	            b = arg_schema.int({ default = 255, min = 0, max = 255 }),
28	        },
29	    }),
30	})
31	```
32	
33	After parsing, read `ctx.io`, `ctx.enabled`, and `ctx.color` instead of reading `args` directly.
34	
35	## `arg_schema.int(options)`
36	
37	Use this for GPIOs, brightness, coordinates, counts, durations, indexes, and other numeric parameters.
38	
39	Options:
40	- `default`: value used when the input is not a number.
41	- `min`: optional lower bound.
42	- `max`: optional upper bound.
43	- `floor`: numbers are floored by default. Set `floor = false` only when the target API accepts decimals.
44	
45	Behavior:
46	- Non-number input returns `default`.
47	- Number input is floored unless `floor = false`.
48	- The result is clamped to `min` and `max` when those bounds are provided.
49	
50	## `arg_schema.bool(options)`
51	
52	Use this for switches and flags.
53	
54	Options:
55	- `default`: value used when the input is not a boolean.
56	
57	Behavior:
58	- Boolean input is preserved.
59	- Non-boolean input returns `default`.
60	
61	## `arg_schema.object(options)`
62	
63	Use this for nested groups such as colors, dimensions, or grouped hardware settings.
64	
65	Options:
66	- `fields`: nested schema table. Each field is normalized with its own spec.
67	- `default`: table of fallback values copied into missing normalized fields.
68	
69	Behavior:
70	- Table input is used as the source object.
71	- Non-table input is treated as an empty object.
72	- Only fields declared in `fields` are normalized.
73	- Missing normalized fields can be filled from `default`.
74	
75	## `arg_schema.parse(raw_args, schema)`
76	
77	Normalize `raw_args` with a schema table and return a new table.
78	
79	Behavior:
80	- If `raw_args` is not a table, it is treated as `{}`.
81	- The returned table contains one normalized value for each schema key.
82	- The original `args` table is not mutated.
83	
84	Example:
85	
86	```lua
87	local ctx = arg_schema.parse(args, {
88	    duration_ms = arg_schema.int({ default = 30000, min = 1 }),
89	    enabled = arg_schema.bool({ default = true }),
90	})
91	```
92	
93	## Practical Rules
94	
95	- Always set explicit defaults for values passed to hardware APIs.
96	- Clamp GPIOs, colors, sizes, counters, and indexes before passing them into modules.
97	- Use `floor = false` only for APIs that explicitly accept decimals.
98	- Keep the schema close to the top of the file so script inputs are easy to inspect.
99	- Do not use this library when invalid input must be rejected with a user-facing error; write explicit validation for that case.

-- --------------------------------------------------------------
-- Show a JPEG image on the 3.5" 4-color e-paper panel.
-- Scaled down to fit the 184x384 panel (never enlarged), centered
-- by default (x/y args override the position).
-- --------------------------------------------------------------

local arg_schema = require("arg_schema")
local image = require("image")
local epaper = require("epaper")

local ctx = arg_schema.parse(args, {
  dither = arg_schema.bool({ default = true }),
  background = arg_schema.int({ default = 1, min = 0, max = 3 }),
  x = arg_schema.int({ default = -1 }),   -- <0 = auto center
  y = arg_schema.int({ default = -1 }),
})

local path = (type(args) == "table" and type(args.path) == "string") and args.path or nil

local function run()
  if not path then
    error("path is required (a readable .jpg file)")
  end

  local frame <close> = image.load_file(path)
  local rgb <close> = image.convert(frame, image.RGB565)
  local info = rgb:info()
  if info.width < 1 or info.height < 1 then
    error("invalid image: " .. path)
  end

  local W, H = epaper.width(), epaper.height()
  -- 等比缩放到屏内，不放大
  local scale = math.min(W / info.width, H / info.height, 1.0)
  local w = math.max(1, math.floor(info.width * scale + 0.5))
  local h = math.max(1, math.floor(info.height * scale + 0.5))
  local x = (ctx.x >= 0) and ctx.x or math.floor((W - w) / 2)
  local y = (ctx.y >= 0) and ctx.y or math.floor((H - h) / 2)

  local small <close> = image.resize(rgb, { width = w, height = h, filter = "bilinear" })

  epaper.init()
  epaper.clear(ctx.background)
  epaper.draw_image(small, x, y, ctx.dither)
  epaper.display()
  epaper.sleep()

  print(string.format(
    "[epaper_show_image] shown: %s (%dx%d -> %dx%d at %d,%d dither=%s background=%d)",
    path, info.width, info.height, w, h, x, y, tostring(ctx.dither), ctx.background
  ))
end

local ok, err = xpcall(run, debug.traceback)
if not ok then
  print("[epaper_show_image] ERROR: " .. tostring(err))
  error(err)
end

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""生成 epaper_show_image skill 的演示图（PC 端 PIL，需重跑时执行）。

三张图覆盖三种缩放场景：
  demo_landscape.jpg 640x480 横图（缩小到 184x138 居中，渐变验证抖动）
  demo_portrait.jpg  360x800 竖图（缩小到 173x384 居中）
  demo_small.jpg     96x96   小图（原尺寸居中，不放大）
"""
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

HERE = Path(__file__).parent
BLACK, WHITE, RED, YELLOW = (0, 0, 0), (255, 255, 255), (255, 0, 0), (255, 255, 0)


def font(size, bold=False):
    path = "C:/Windows/Fonts/msyhbd.ttc" if bold else "C:/Windows/Fonts/msyh.ttc"
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
    except OSError:
        return ImageFont.truetype("C:/Windows/Fonts/msyh.ttc", size)


def gradient_rect(d, box, c_top, c_bottom):
    """垂直渐变矩形（验证 Floyd-Steinberg 抖动效果）"""
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = box
    h = y1 - y0
    for i in range(h):
        t = i / max(1, h - 1)
        c = tuple(int(a + (b - a) * t) for a, b in zip(c_top, c_bottom))
        d.line([(x0, y0 + i), (x1, y0 + i)], fill=c)


# 1. 横图：日落（红黄渐变天空 + 黑色山 + 白月亮）
img = Image.new("RGB", (640, 480), WHITE)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
gradient_rect(d, (0, 0, 639, 340), (200, 20, 20), (255, 220, 60))
d.ellipse([480, 60, 540, 120], fill=WHITE)
d.polygon([(0, 340), (140, 200), (260, 340), (380, 240), (520, 340)], fill=BLACK)
gradient_rect(d, (0, 340, 639, 479), (60, 60, 60), (20, 20, 20))
img.save(HERE / "demo_landscape.jpg", quality=85)

# 2. 竖图：海报（黄底红栏黑字，验证竖图缩放 + 中文渲染）
img = Image.new("RGB", (360, 800), YELLOW)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
d.rectangle([0, 0, 359, 120], fill=RED)
t = "智能电子工卡"
f = font(52, bold=True)
bb = d.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
d.text(((360 - (bb[2] - bb[0])) // 2, 32), t, font=f, fill=WHITE)
f = font(28)
t = "ESP32-P4 + 墨水屏"
bb = d.textbbox((0, 0), t, font=f)
d.text(((360 - (bb[2] - bb[0])) // 2, 180), t, font=f, fill=BLACK)
gradient_rect(d, (40, 260, 319, 360), RED, YELLOW)
for i, s in enumerate(["拍照", "录音", "AI 对话", "云端推图"]):
    d.rectangle([60, 400 + i * 80, 100, 440 + i * 80], fill=BLACK)
    d.text((120, 405 + i * 80), s, font=font(26), fill=BLACK)
img.save(HERE / "demo_portrait.jpg", quality=85)

# 3. 小图：96x96 图标（红心，验证原尺寸居中）
img = Image.new("RGB", (96, 96), WHITE)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
d.ellipse([8, 20, 46, 58], fill=RED)
d.ellipse([50, 20, 88, 58], fill=RED)
d.polygon([(14, 44), (82, 44), (48, 88)], fill=RED)
img.save(HERE / "demo_small.jpg", quality=85)

print("done:", ", ".join(p.name for p in sorted(HERE.glob("demo_*.jpg"))))

local epaper = require("epaper")
local image = require("image")
epaper.init()               -- GPIO + panel init (idempotent)
epaper.clear(color)         -- fill the frame buffer with color (no refresh yet)
epaper.text("Hello", 0, 0, 24, 0)  -- draw text into the frame buffer
epaper.draw_image(frame, x, y, dither)  -- quantize an image.frame into the buffer
epaper.display()            -- flush the frame buffer to the panel (slow refresh)
epaper.sleep()              -- put the panel into deep sleep
```

Colors: `0` black, `1` white, `2` yellow, `3` red. Font sizes: `8`, `16`, `24`
(ASCII only). `text()` clips anything outside the 184×384 panel; `\n` moves to
the next line.

`draw_image(frame, x, y, dither)` takes an `image.frame` (any format the image
module can convert — RGB565 is requested internally), quantizes it to the
4-color palette and draws it at (x, y), clipped. `dither` defaults to true
(Floyd-Steinberg, best for photos; pass false for line art). Compose with
`clear()` + `text()` and flush once. See the `epaper_show_image` skill for a
fit-and-center helper with demo images.
